english.title: Fail to comply with information notice re registerable beneficial owners
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without reasonable excuse, failed to comply with an information notice issued on **(..SPECIFY DATE OF ISSUE..) under

(A)_[section 12]_
(B)_[section 13]_

of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022 in that **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(1) and (5) of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwithout reasonable excusefailed to comply withnotice issued under section 12 OR section 13 of the Act

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or a fine
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or fine
Time limit for prosecutions:
None
Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
